name: v3.46.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Increase license cache offline grace period by @jvcalderon in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19618
* Bump fflate from 0.4.8 to 0.4.9 in the all-non-major-security group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19622
* chore: upgrade Babel to v8 by @melohagan in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19614
* Fix for slack DMs by @deanhannigan in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19636
* Merge Cloud hotfixes back to master by @calexiou in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19637
* Add vulnerability fix and release process documentation by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19632
* Allow agent invocations from automations as requester by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19575
* feat: password config via ENV VAR by @Dakuan in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19581
* [19573] Fix seeding single user columns by @melohagan in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19609
* Feat/approval policies by @deanhannigan in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19620
* Bump joi from 18.2.1 to 18.2.5 in the all-non-major-security group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19641
* Bump hono from 4.13.0 to 4.13.7 in the all-non-major-security group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19644
* Fixes off-by-one days in calendar week view by @mikesealey in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19648
* Bump vitest from 4.1.10 to 5.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19646
* Bump nodemailer from 9.0.4 to 9.1.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19645
* Expose errors from escalated tools by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19651
* Ship tool escalations for all by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19639
* Remove legacy escalation code by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19649
* Prevent duplicate escalation after approved tool execution by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19652
* Allows creators to hide the weekend-days in the calendar. by @mikesealey in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19663
* Merge Cloud hotfixes back to master by @budibase-release-automation[bot] in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19664
* Rename appStore to workspaceStore in builder package by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19658
* chore: use Quay MinIO image by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19675
* ci: run CLA Assistant for cloud PRs by @melohagan in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19662
* Cloud backmerge by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19676
* Use shared ECR MinIO mirror in builds and tests by @calexiou in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19677
* Backmerge from cloud by @adrinr in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19678

## New Contributors
* @budibase-release-automation[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/pull/19664

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/compare/v3.45.0...v3.46.0
